# opencode-run

A recording of OpenCode 1.19.4, workflow run 42629412567 on 2026-11-09. `go run ./scripts/record verify` passed on it before and after it was placed here.

OpenCode's own figure for the run: 0.00153317 USD, the sum of the `cost` of the 2 `step_finish` lines in `stream.jsonl`. OpenCode prices each step from its own price list.
